description:
Spatial convergence of the FLUX-FORM first-order-upwind ZONAL advection operator grids/latlon3d/rules/upwind1_flux_D_lon_periodic, driven by problems/latlon3d_advection_zonal_upwind_flux. 

FORCED-STEADY (TRUNCATION) IDIOM, matching the vertical sibling latlon3d_advection_vertical_upwind_flux: q*(lambda) = 2 + sin(lambda) is an exact steady state of the forced equation (the state is seeded with its exact CELL MEAN, and src is the exact flux divergence -- for a finite-volume cell simply the difference of the exact face fluxes times the exact spherical weight), so the drift measured at t = 0.1 IS the operator's truncation error and the observed rate is the truncation order. Donor-cell upwinding is first order, hence expected_order 1.0. 

THE SWEEP REFINES NLON ONLY, AND THAT IS THE POINT. NLAT = 5 and NLEV = 4 are pinned at the problem's rule-import edge. The polar metric weights are therefore EXERCISED but not REFINED: at NLAT = 5 the half-polar cap rows carry dphi_lat/dS_lat ~ 5.2 against ~1.0 in the tropics, so the cap rows dominate the Linf norm at every rung -- but because dphi never shrinks, the lat-lon coordinate singularity that stalls the MERIDIONAL operator's pointwise Linf under refinement (measured in grids/latlon3d/rules/upwind1_flux_D_lat_polar: orders decaying 0.47/0.24/0.12) cannot contaminate the zonal order. What is left is a clean first-order zonal check. 

THE LADDER STARTS AT 32, NOT 16. Donor-cell upwinding was measured PRE-ASYMPTOTIC at 16 in the vertical wave (a 16/32/64/128 ladder gave Linf pairwise 0.34/0.78/0.91, median 0.78 -- missing first order by 0.22), and the fix there was to measure in the asymptotic regime rather than to slacken order_tolerance, since a loose tolerance on a pre-asymptotic ladder is exactly how a genuinely inconsistent scheme slips through. The same discipline is applied here. 

WHAT THIS GUARDS. The wind U = U0 (0.5 + cos lambda) a(j) b(k) is a declared THREE-DIMENSIONAL face-staggered field on the lon_nodes axis that CHANGES SIGN (westward on the 120-degree arc around lambda = 180), so both branches of the donor-cell selection fire in every row, and the a(j) b(k) modulation means a stencil that mis-indexed U as a column profile would be caught rather than silently agreeing. No pre-existing zonal operator on this grid can represent either property: upwind1_D_lon_periodic and ppm_D_lon_periodic match a bare D(q, wrt: lon) with the velocity supplied from outside, and they hard-code a single flow direction. The rule additionally enforces the periodic wrap ITSELF (cell NLON's east face reuses U[1], never U[NLON+1]), which makes sum_i D exactly 0.0 and is verified out-of-band rather than here: this manifest measures ORDER, not conservation.
